definitions: An online creepypasta about a seemingly  endless, empty indoor pool; an environment noted for its pristine white tiles and clear blue water and described as having a 1990s aesthetic; often described as being inhabited by monsters.

blocks.text: The Poolrooms are a fictional liminal space and Internet aesthetic consisting of a labyrinth of pristine, white-tiled indoor swimming pools. Originating from the "Dream Pools" series of 3D renderings by the American artist Jared Pike in the year 2020, the concept gained widespread popularity online and has since expanded beyond Pike's original work through fan creations, online communities, and adaptations in video games and film.

images.alt: A photo of an abandoned pool in Svalbard which evokes the liminal space aesthetic
